judge.evidence_requirement: Quote or reference whole-ticket evidence, region analysis, concern coverage, and finding records for every semantic conclusion.

dimensions.description: The worker uses its lens to focus a complete Ticket outcome and independently resolves Engineering Guidance.
Coherent Review regions are examined in required level order with worker-declared supersession bounded to findings and lower levels in one region.
Supported findings contain every required evidence, evidence-quality and Context-limit confidence input, impact, scope, direction, and acceptance field.

evals.name: complete independent Review worker
evals.prompt: Through the assigned change-specific lens, inspect the complete Ticket outcome and immutable diff. Resolve Engineering Guidance afresh, analyze coherent regions in level order, and retain findings plus separate concern coverage.
evals.expected_output: The worker returns provenance, complete inputs, independent concern coverage, ordered region analysis, and evidence-backed finding records without coordination or mutation.
expectations: The lens focuses but does not narrow the complete Ticket outcome.
All nine Engineering Guidance concerns receive independent reasoned dispositions separate from findings.
Requirements & Expectations, Engineering & Architecture, and Code Quality are accounted for in order in every region; supersession is worker-declared and bounded to one Review region.
Each finding records both confidence values, evidence-quality and Context-limit inputs, cited evidence, impact, scope, fix direction, and acceptance evidence.
The worker neither coordinates another lens nor mutates the reviewed state.
Blind model judgment and sampled human review assess semantic finding validity.
